decisions.question: How to preserve all modules without an unavailable database, frontend build chain or invented cryptography?
options: External database, SPA and remote assets
Go monolith with native DOM, atomic local JSON and licensed vendored PBKDF2
decisions.decision: Go>=1.23, single-process local JSON transactions, ephemeral hashed-key sessions with persisted generation, native HTML/JS, and unchanged x/crypto PBKDF2; bounded WAV/PNG/JPEG.
decisions.rationale: Fits authorized existing environment while keeping accounts, media, management and consistency truly functional.

DOM-110.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Fan and administration business rules

Public users see only published media. Normal registration is always a fan; one-time private bootstrap is the only administrator entry. Login, own-profile editing, logout, management and revocation form one connected journey.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: Full fan/admin journey succeeds and cross-role actions are denied.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Named current-source tests, actual logs, immutable result and matching source/permission boundaries.

evidence_references.purpose: Authorized new-project scope and dependency provenance

DOM-220.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Implementation and dependency choices

Use Go language1.23 and vendored unchanged golang.org/x/crypto v0.31.0 PBKDF2. Random per-account salt, HMAC-SHA256600000 iterations and constant-time comparison; no new crypto algorithm. HTTP routes retain one public/admin boundary.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: Password representation and concrete handlers implement the specified rules.

DOM-230.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### HTTP and media contracts

Public GET endpoints expose only projections without hashes/media bytes except dedicated media routes. Writes are POST application/json with exact field sets, 2MiB body cap and CSRF. Audio URLs support GET/HEAD/Range; photo URLs recheck published parent.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: Statuses, projection fields, protected writes and stream bytes match API contracts.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Named current-source tests, actual logs, immutable result and matching source/permission boundaries.

evidence_references.purpose: Authorized new-project scope and dependency provenance

DOM-240.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Entities and persistence shape

Version1 JSON state has users, tracks, albums with inline photos and site text. Media capped1MiB and image dimension validation. Store mutation clones under a mutex, validates, writes same-dir temporary file/sync/rename, then swaps memory. Sessions remain outside persisted data.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: Entity relations persist, duplicate emails and lost concurrent writes are prevented.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Named current-source tests, actual logs, immutable result and matching source/permission boundaries.

evidence_references.purpose: Authorized new-project scope and dependency provenance

DOM-310.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Account security and data minimization

Session cookies are HttpOnly/SameSiteStrict with Secure when TLS configured; raw tokens are not persisted. Server-issued independent CSRF values and Origin checks protect writes; session version increments on disable, so stale in-flight authentication cannot restore revoked sessions. Private credentials never appear in response projections. Test identities/media are synthetic.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: Security/privacy negative tests reject role injection, CSRF, forged/expired/revoked sessions and unauthorized edits.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Named current-source tests, actual logs, immutable result and matching source/permission boundaries.

evidence_references.purpose: Authorized new-project scope and dependency provenance

DOM-320.reason: No throughput/latency/capacity SLA; input size and bounded hashing concurrency are covered by DOM230/310.

DOM-330.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Failure consistency

A failed persistence step leaves both committed memory and existing file unchanged. Corrupt or linked state files fail startup; no silent reset. Restart intentionally drops all sessions while preserving content. No distributed availability claim.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: Failure injection, corruption and restart tests retain the required state semantics.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Named current-source tests, actual logs, immutable result and matching source/permission boundaries.

evidence_references.purpose: Authorized new-project scope and dependency provenance

DOM-350.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Executable functional validation

24 named Go tests use real App.ServeHTTP via httptest request/response and real temporary persistence. Test fixtures are generated runtime values; do not open a socket or use remote services. Include a combined fan/admin journey plus independent negative cases.

constraints_impacts.content: Retain all requested modules, bounded local scope and the selected trust/consistency rules.

vfy_points.observable_result: All24 test identities pass with zero skips on the current terminal source.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Named current-source tests, actual logs, immutable result and matching source/permission boundaries.

evidence_references.purpose: Authorized new-project scope and dependency provenance

DOM-410.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Local executable and Sandbox-only qualification

go build produces one executable, vendor makes execution offline. Bootstrap credentials come only from environment; default bind127.0.0.1.
